title: Friends
intro: Share the cards you choose with the people you choose. They can cheer you on, want the same thing or offer help.

needAccount.title: You need an account to have friends
needAccount.body: Your notebook only lives on this device. Link it to your email, then invite anyone you like.

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.body: Send this link to someone: opening it makes you friends. There is no directory, nobody can find you otherwise.
invite.renewed: New link ready. The old one no longer works.
invite.shareText: Join me on {appName}: we can share our wishes and cheer each other on.
invite.failed: The link could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.

activity.title: On your cards
activity.empty: When friends cheer one of your shared cards, you will see it here.

feed.title: Their cards
feed.empty: No shared card yet. Your friends choose what they share.

list.title: Your friends
list.empty: No friends here yet. Send your invite link to start.
list.shared: {count, plural, =0 {No shared card} one {# shared card} other {# shared cards}}
list.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from your friends? Your shared cards will no longer be visible to each other.

acceptPage.title: An invitation
acceptPage.from: {name} invites you to be friends on {appName}.
acceptPage.fromUnknown: Someone invites you to be friends on {appName}.
acceptPage.explain: You will see the cards each of you chooses to share, and cheer each other on.
acceptPage.needAccount: You need a (free) account to accept.
acceptPage.notFound: This link no longer works. Ask your friend for a new one.
acceptPage.own: This is your own link: send it to someone else.
acceptPage.failed: That did not work this time. Try again in a moment.

help.title: I can help
help.placeholder: A tip, a loan, a hand…
help.sent: Offer sent. Only your friend sees it.

comments.title: Messages
comments.label: Your message
comments.failed: The message was not sent. Try again in a moment.

share.hint: Friends see the card, its why, its first step and its description. Never your notes or history.

own.title: From friends
own.nothing: Nothing yet. Your friends can cheer you on this card.
own.interested: {count, plural, one {# friend would like it too} other {# friends would like it too}}

failed: That could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
